claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 August 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Brig T W Rowland, Morrish, Cette, June 6, and Gibraltar
July 8, with wines, to John Swan. Was detained at Gibral-
tar 22 days by strong westerly winds; from July 10 had very
light winds and calms; July 24 lat 36 30, lon 34[?] 40, passed a
vessel, supposed an Am bark, totally dismasted.
